decision: On 2026-10-01 agalwood authorized corrective revisions until the first formal Release succeeds in response to the disclosed .4 scope and unchanged 42 residual Action advisories (1 Critical, 18 High, 19 Medium, 4 Low), with the existing deadline of 2026-10-15 UTC. This record binds only v9.0.2-motrix.4 to its exact source lock, every workflow byte, supporting assessment, complete same-day audit report and official full-SHA Action references. Formal .3 run 36831228925 passed six candidate builds, four independent rebuilds, six secret-free approvals and final grants, then failed closed on POSIX syntax in the Windows PowerShell risk recheck. It was cancelled while macOS awaited approval; no signing Secret or Release was reached. All prior annotated tags remain immutable and their scope records are not reused. The .4 correction uses native PowerShell argument arrays and explicit validator exit-code propagation, fixes the Windows packaging payload parameter, and adds real PowerShell parsing and risk-command positive/negative regressions on required native Windows x64/ARM64 CI and secret-free pre-sign approvals. Fixtures are test-only temporary data, never production approval inputs. Existing binary-mode protected readers, deterministic macOS ad-hoc baseline and read-only bounded source-built NASM evidence remain unchanged. BUILD_REVISION changes, but source archives/URLs, toolchains, official Action commits and all inventoried advisories are unchanged. Audit 36807648066 remains the same-day complete inventory; no vulnerability is claimed fixed or wholly unreachable, including cache service/extraction risks before validation and signature type-binding risk. Publication remains conditional on all required exact-commit CI checks, file/race/size/hash guards, independent clean rebuilds, Developer ID signing/notarization, Ed25519 authentication, independent final verification, Immutable Releases and protected-Environment confirmations. Further corrective revisions require fresh exact-scope records. New advisories, expiry extensions or unrelated source/Action updates require a new human decision. This limited record grants no Environment approval, no exception for another tag or unrecorded changed scope, and no publication after the deadline.
